experiment: StableAnimator basic 8 GB reference-image pose-transfer preflight
hardware: 8 GB GPU; model CPU offload; FP16 SVD components

runtime.access: pass; the official checkpoint repository contains the required SVD component files and is publicly downloadable
runtime.custom_compatibility: The upstream runner moved all models to GPU. A /tmp-only compatibility copy used FP16 component variants and model CPU offload, and removed three forced GPU moves inside the custom pipeline.
runtime.frame_storage: pass; 512x512, 4 frames, decode_chunk_size=1, 10 and 25 denoising steps both saved PNG frames
runtime.pose_preprocessing: DWPose ran with CPUExecutionProvider because the available onnxruntime build did not expose CUDAExecutionProvider.

reference_contract: teal bob with silver hair clip
navy horizontal flap bag at right hip

results.case: neutral pose, official aligned DWPose map, 10 steps
results.observed: Full body, face, teal hair, white jacket, teal trousers, white sneakers, navy flap bag, and one diagonal strap remained visible across four frames. The pose is effectively a reference reconstruction, so it does not prove pose transfer.

results.case: deep crouch, official aligned DWPose map, 10 steps
results.observed: The official linear body alignment stretched the crouch skeleton against the standing reference. Output was enlarged and cropped; full body, face, and bag gates failed.

results.case: deep crouch, raw DWPose map without alignment, 10 and 25 steps
results.observed: The output moved to a crouch-like full-body pose, but face detail and hair clip were lost, the bag became an undefined blue rectangle, and the diagonal strap no longer formed a valid bag contract. Increasing to 25 steps did not repair those gates.

results.case: standing reach, raw DWPose map without alignment, 25 steps
results.observed: The full-body box, arm reach direction, face, white jacket, teal trousers, and sneakers remained usable. Hair clip was not reliable, the navy flap bag disappeared, and the white background confirms this is foreground animation rather than a final scene cut.

usable_scope: Candidate foreground pose stage for moderate full-body poses only, pending an independent face/clip and bag repair stage plus a separate scene/camera stage.
stop_rules: Do not claim camera or location variation from this model; its documented training guidance assumes static backgrounds.
Do not use official linear pose alignment for compressed crouch poses.
Do not attach scene merge or inpainting until a face/clip and bag contract repair path is separately verified.
removed_artifacts: Temporary source patches, runners, pose maps, generated frames, GIFs, and downloaded checkpoints after the result is recorded
